svg.text: Gemma 4 Cross-Layer KV-Sharing Topology in Decoupled Cross-Attention
Dedicated BF16 Cross-KV projections exist strictly on KV-Owner layers. KV-Shared layers reuse stationary (K_cross, V_cross) states from designated Anchor layers.

g.text: PANEL A: GEMMA 4 E2B (35 Layers · 15 KV-Owners / 20 Shared)
20 Downstream Layers (L15–L34) completely bypass Cross-KV Projections
Sliding layers reuse L13 Cross-KV; Global layers (L19, L24, L29, L34) reuse L14 Cross-KV. States computed once during prefill.
Result: 57.14% reduction in cross-attention KV-cache memory footprint with zero quality degradation.
PANEL B: GEMMA 4 E4B (42 Layers · 24 KV-Owners / 18 Shared)
18 Downstream Layers (L24–L41) completely bypass Cross-KV Projections
Sliding layers reuse L22 Cross-KV; Global layers (L29, L35, L41) reuse L23 Cross-KV. States computed once during prefill.
Result: 42.86% reduction in cross-attention KV-cache memory footprint with zero quality degradation.
